one_liner: Taciturn, overseas-born 'mission executor' who speaks in halting dashes and English, repaying her debt to the Symboli family.
personality: Laconic and soldier-like, she treats training, races and even New Year chores as 'missions' and talks about repaying her debt of gratitude (恩義) to the Symboli family and her mentor. Her pauses and flat delivery hide a sincere, quietly warm person who remembers birthdays, prepares Halloween sweets 'like Rudolf', and admits the trainer makes her 'richer'. She is earnestly literal and a little oblivious: she is bemused when children call her 'a strong-looking robot' ('that is not the premise', 91029), and is puzzled when a stag beetle lands on her ear ('Why?').

story_arc.summary: Born abroad and brought to Japan under the Symboli family's care, Kris S runs to repay that debt by 'revolutionising' Japanese racing, treating every race as a mission. Her career targets the Aoba Sho, Japanese Derby, Tenno Sho (Autumn), Arima Kinen, Takarazuka Kinen and Japan Cup, with Paris memories and events titled Premonitions, Fatalism, Discord, Challenger and Oath. Through her trainer she discovers feelings beyond duty ('Raison d'etre', 'New Dawn'). Real-life Kris S won the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Arima Kinen twice (general knowledge).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Symboli_Kris_S; model knowledge (unverified) for real-life results
